summary: 0/3 steps. Completions default max_tokens is modeled as max_model_len - prompt (131070), not 16; the response lacks created, logprobs, stop_reason and usage.total_tokens.
5/6 steps. The SSE shape, role chunk, finish chunk, usage chunk and [DONE] are right, and there's no usage without stream_options; continuous_usage_stats isn't modeled.

3/4 steps. check_stop stops on EOS and blocks are freed in the same step; the EOS text is skipped as a stop-terminated token (expectation's mechanism corrected); the chat choice has no stop_reason field.

1/3 steps. The stop string is matched in the API-process detokenizer and aborted in the engine core; the stop token id is matched in the scheduler with stop_reason 87126; responses carry no stop_reason.
2/2 steps. ignore_eos gives 32 tokens and length; min_tokens 8 masks EOS in the sampler, so the first stop is token 9.

1/4 steps. max_tokens 0 gives 400 but error.param is dropped; min>max gives 400 but is raised in InputProcessor after generate starts, not in SamplingParams; max_completion_tokens wins; stream_options without stream isn't validated (200).

1/3 steps. No max_tokens > max_model_len check (200, clamped); clamping to the remaining room works (run scaled); a prompt of exactly max_model_len gives 400 on chat but 500 on completions (expectation's mechanism corrected: max_tokens 0 is rejected by SamplingParams).
0/3 steps. No UTF-8 hold-back; a stop string spanning tokens is never matched (only the new token's text is searched, no hold-back); include_stop_str_in_output is ignored.
0/3 steps. Special-token text appears despite skip_special_tokens (the flag is unused); no logprobs in responses; top_logprobs 25 > max_logprobs 20 is accepted.

0/4 steps. Grammar pieces exist but the serving path never calls grammar_init, never waits in WAITING_FOR_STRUCTURED_OUTPUT_GRAMMAR, and always passes a null bitmask; the output is unconstrained. A wire-shape json_schema aborts the run (the model reads json_schema.json_schema, not the 'schema' alias).

0/2 steps. An unparseable schema isn't rejected (200, sent to the engine core); validation is modeled only for outlines. Truncation ends with length but there's no grammar in the path. Expectation narrowed: with auto, a compilable-elsewhere schema falls back rather than 400.
